resources.string: Unencrypted connection

This address starts with http://, so the WebDAV username and password and the whole backup archive travel across the network unencrypted. Anyone on the same Wi-Fi can read them or replace the archive. Continue only on a trusted local network; use https:// anywhere else.
Use http anyway

This replaces the whole library with the archive on the server. It is a library backup/restore, not a sync between devices. Every note currently on this device is replaced, and notes you created or edited on this device after that backup was written will be lost. The app automatically keeps the database it replaces, so you can roll back with the Restore previous database entry below.

This replaces the whole library with the backup in the selected file. It is a library backup/restore, not a sync between devices. Every note currently on this device is replaced, and notes you created or edited on this device after that backup was written will be lost. The app automatically keeps the database it replaces, so you can roll back with the Restore previous database entry below.

This replaces the whole library with the automatic backup made %1$s. It is a library backup/restore, not a sync between devices. Every note currently on this device is replaced, and notes created or edited after that backup will be lost. The app automatically keeps the database it replaces, so you can roll back with the Restore previous database entry below.
Restoring backup…
Restore previous database
The database the last restore replaced, saved %1$s (%2$s). Restoring it undoes that restore; notes written since then are lost.
Restore
Restore the previous database?
This puts back the database that the last restore replaced. Notes created or edited since that restore are replaced by it, and the app restarts to reopen the database.
Previous database restored. Restarting…
Could not restore the previous database: %1$s
The header of this file could not be read. Leave the field blank if the backup has no password.

The saved scratchpad content cannot be decrypted on this device, possibly because the encryption key was reset. It is left exactly as stored and saving is disabled so the original text is not overwritten. Copy anything you still need out of another backup first.
Not saved: the stored scratchpad could not be decrypted, so it was left unchanged.
The flashcards could not be encrypted, so nothing was saved. The stored deck is unchanged.
Conflict copy restored

This device now holds the notes from the conflict copy. The server still has the other device\'s archive, so the next backup would park another conflict copy there. Choose which library should become the canonical copy on the server.
Use this device\'s notes as the canonical remote
Keep the remote copy
TXT contains text only and does not include images or recordings.
